Check: Count 30 columns × 45 rows; confirm 2.54 mm pitch and actual edge offsets.
Acceptance / evidence: Measured grid and actual board dimensions recorded

Check: Check all pad isolation, edge strips and top-to-bottom plating with a meter.
Acceptance / evidence: No assumed ties; install wires to actual soldered leads

Check: Dry-fit 30-pin DevKit on two removable 15-pin sockets at C10/C20, R5–R19.
Acceptance / evidence: 25.4 mm header-row spacing and all photographed labels match; otherwise revise before soldering

Check: Check DevKit body/antenna envelope, EN/BOOT access, USB plug and cable bend above row 1.
Acceptance / evidence: Actual hardware clears all headers and passives; no component underneath socket body

Check: Dry-fit supplied headers and female jumper plugs; check bulk capacitor diameter/pitch/height.
Acceptance / evidence: Envelopes fit and polarity/access is unambiguous; generic drawing is not measurement

Check: Plan mounting and strain relief using actual enclosure.
Acceptance / evidence: No drilling coordinates released; no pin/trace damage or bending from mating force

Check: Keep C17–29/R28–43 clear on both faces.
Acceptance / evidence: No component, wire loop or cable strain relief occupies pulse reserve

Check: Compare every installed part pin to pins.csv and every insulated wire to wires.csv.
Acceptance / evidence: Correct endpoints and net; NC pins untouched; record meter continuity rather than visual check alone

Check: Inspect underside joints and adjacent-pad isolation, especially socket rows and ground distribution.
Acceptance / evidence: No unintended bridges; sleeve crossings; no exposed wire spans

Check: Test JP_EXT open/closed continuity.
Acceptance / evidence: Removed shunt disconnects external 3.3 V from board rail; never parallel external and USB supply

Check: Test both sense links open/closed; confirm complete 10k/10k/1k networks and capacitor returns.
Acceptance / evidence: No raw P1/P2 to ADC path; sense input cannot be applied to an unpowered receiver

Check: Check capacitor polarity and resistor values with components identified.
Acceptance / evidence: 10k top/bottom, 1k series; 47uF positive on board rail; no joystick GPIO35 pull-up

Check: Keep ESP32/screens/sense/UART/joystick disconnected; test regulated board rail with bounded source/load.
Acceptance / evidence: Record 3.20–3.38 V under intended load and polarity; no positive Pi supply connection

Check: Measure source rating/current/ripple with ESP32 and maximum physically connected OLED load.
Acceptance / evidence: No brownout, unacceptable droop or regulator overheating; budget all powered screens, not just active modes

Check: External supply cable physically unplugged, JP_EXT removed, both sense links open, peripherals that can drive inputs disconnected.
Acceptance / evidence: USB powers DevKit/board alone; unplug USB before restoring external mode

Check: Identify each SSD1306 header order, supply rating, pull-ups and cable length before plugging.
Acceptance / evidence: Board header is 3V3/GND/SCL/SDA; map by signal, not assumed straight-through pin order

Check: Measure combined SCL pull-up resistance with power off and rise time/low level when powered.
Acceptance / evidence: R_SCL stays DNP unless needed; excessive parallel module pull-ups corrected before six-port operation

Check: Test each port individually at 100 kHz, then the intended three active positions and all connected loads.
Acceptance / evidence: No wrong-screen addressing, stuck bus, reset or stale capsule presence; qualify 400 kHz separately

Check: Using a measured bounded DC source, test each input at 0, ~1, ~2.5 and up to 5.25 V with board powered.
Acceptance / evidence: ADC side nominally half input; compare DMM readings; record offset/gain, noise, settling and saturation

Check: Apply equal voltages to both raw inputs, then a known difference; swap P1/P2 with power removed.
Acceptance / evidence: Difference follows polarity, equal-input residual recorded; never apply negative voltage to either raw input

Check: Disconnect diagnostic stimulus, keep output drivers high-Z; test known matrix routes and changed route generations.
Acceptance / evidence: Only stable acknowledged route pairs are accepted; no test-source backfeed, unintended path or unpowered input drive

Check: Connect only 3V3/GND/X/Y; test center and four directions.
Acceptance / evidence: GPIO36/39; no SW wire or GPIO35 click pull-up; map physical directions after mounting

Check: Pi pin8 TX -> board RX(GPIO32); board TX(GPIO33) -> Pi pin10 RX; common GND.
Acceptance / evidence: 115200 8N1 bidirectional PING/PONG; both receivers powered; old GPIO16/17 test mapping NOT used

Check: Run three active measurement positions, OLED dirty updates, joystick and UART; test disconnect/reconnect and held inputs.
Acceptance / evidence: Record sampling/refresh latencies and invalid-data behavior; do not claim 10 Hz until measured

Check: Check expansion header and blank area.
Acceptance / evidence: No pulse/current output hardware installed; raw GPIO must never energize student contacts

Check: Record completed audit and bench logs with equipment, firmware, board revision, links and actual values.
Acceptance / evidence: Release only the measured scope; CP acceptance and final requirement compliance remain separate
